name: Niigaki Mayuri
source:
Magazine model high school student. Her beauty is enough to turn heads. The thorny girl doesn't open up easily to others. At the shared residence, she plays the role of a tsukkomi in a comedy act. Her Mamiya used to be a school teacher who spent time with her after school.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/MAMIYA]TV Tropes[/url]]
